effects: Pulls `amount` sfrxETH (the vault collateral 0xac3E…e38F) from the signer to the vault via safeTransferFrom, which uses the signer's allowance.
Mints vault active shares for `onBehalfOf`, not the signer, in a number computed from the vault's stake and shares (previewDeposit).
formats.shown: Deposit X sfrxETH into the vault, with the stake credited to the named beneficiary.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted to onBehalfOf is computed on chain and not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_)`, which depends on storage. The descriptor shows only #.amount and #.onBehalfOf.
findings.fix: None needed. A descriptor cannot compute this value.

effects: Burns the signer's active vault shares, enough to cover `amount` sfrxETH (rounded up by previewWithdraw). Reverts if the signer does not hold enough.
Adds `amount` sfrxETH to the next epoch's withdrawal queue and credits the withdrawal shares to `claimer`. Only `claimer` can claim them later, and no tokens move now.
The queued amount stays slashable until the epoch ends, so the later claim can be smaller than `amount`.
formats.shown: Request an X sfrxETH withdrawal from the vault, with the claim owned by the named claimer.

findings.title: withdraw: the shares burned from the signer and slashing of the queued amount are not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: `burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake())`. onSlash lowers `withdrawals[currentEpoch_ + 1]`. Both depend on storage.
findings.fix: None needed. You could add a note that the claim becomes available after the next epoch and may be reduced by slashing.

effects: Burns `shares` of the signer's active vault shares. Reverts if the signer holds fewer.
Converts them to sfrxETH at the current rate (previewRedeem), queues that amount for the next epoch and credits the withdrawal shares to `claimer`. No tokens move now.
formats.shown: Queue a withdrawal of N raw vault shares, with the claim owned by the named claimer.

findings.title: redeem: shares are shown as a raw 18-decimal integer when a unit format could scale them.
findings.evidence: ERC4626Math.sol `_decimalsOffset()` returns 0, so shares use the collateral's 18-decimal scale. The descriptor has `#.shares` format `raw`. Case 2 shows 'Queue 987654321123456789 raw shares'.
findings.fix: Use format `unit` with params {decimals: 18, base: "shares"} so the screen reads about 0.9877 shares.

findings.title: redeem: the sfrxETH amount queued for the redeemed shares is computed on chain and not shown.
findings.fix: None needed. A descriptor cannot compute this value.

effects: Uses up the signer's claim for `epoch` (isWithdrawalsClaimed set to true). Reverts if the epoch is not over or the claim is already used.
Sends the signer's withdrawable sfrxETH for that epoch, an amount read from storage, from the vault to `recipient`.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawal for epoch N and send it to the named recipient.

findings.title: claim: the screen never says the asset sent to the recipient is sfrxETH.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount)`, where collateral is sfrxETH. The intent reads 'Claim withdrawal' and the sentence 'Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'. No field names the token.
findings.fix: Use intent 'Claim sfrxETH withdrawal' and sentence 'Claim sfrxETH from epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claim: the amount paid out is read from storage and cannot be shown.
findings.fix: None needed. The amount is not in the calldata.

effects: Uses up the signer's claim for every epoch listed. Reverts if any epoch is not over or already claimed.
Sends the total of the signer's withdrawable sfrxETH for those epochs, read from storage, from the vault to `recipient` in one transfer.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawals for the listed epochs and send them to the named recipient.

findings.title: claimBatch: the screen never says the asset sent to the recipient is sfrxETH.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount)`. The intent reads 'Claim withdrawals' and the sentence 'Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'. No field names the token.
findings.fix: Use intent 'Claim sfrxETH withdrawals' and sentence 'Claim sfrxETH from epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claimBatch: the total paid out is read from storage and cannot be shown.
findings.fix: None needed. The amount is not in the calldata.
